source_of_truth: controllers.js (classicalDemon, randomController, annController, drosophilaController, connectomeController, neverGateController)

E1.label: Classical Maxwell Demon
E1.question: Does an adaptive-threshold classical demon sort an ideal gas, and at what thermodynamic cost?

E2.label: Artificial Neural Demon
E2.question: Can a small learned ANN policy match the engineered demon on the same observations?

E3.label: Drosophila-Inspired Network
E3.question: Does a PN→KC→MB-output LIF network with dopamine-gated plasticity learn the demon task?
E3.note: Preregistered 20-seed validation campaign ALREADY RUN (research_data/validation/E3_VALIDATION.csv + E3R2_*): primary paired late-early goodBadRatio verdict NO_EVIDENCE; secondary dTfinal/sortEntropy drosophila-vs-random SUCCESS.
metrics: same as E1 row schema + layerRates, fireVec

E4.label: Connectome-Constrained (4A/4B/4C)
E4.question: Does real FAFB wiring beat restricted-pathway and shuffled controls at the demon task?

conditions.connectome_4B: FAFB circuit, plasticity restricted to sensory pathway, opticDrive 0.25
conditions.connectome_4C: degree-preserving SHUFFLED circuit (seed 7), plasticity full, opticDrive 0.25

E4.note: Preregistered 12-seed + 10-shuffle-draw validation ALREADY RUN (E4_VALIDATION.csv): primary 4A vs 4C test goodBadRatio verdict NO_EVIDENCE (g=-0.11). Secondary 4A vs 4B DIRECTION_ONLY (g=+0.39).
metrics: same as E1 row schema + layerRates, fireVec
E4.paper_role: core connectome-constraint test (anatomy vs shuffled wiring)

E5.label: Full Comparator Study
E5.question: Head-to-head: classical vs ANN vs drosophila vs connectome vs shuffled connectome, one seeded run with CIs.

E6.label: Jet-Closure Paradox (causal decomposition)
E6.question: Decompose ΔH causally: demon vs random vs never-gate with the jet running — is ΔH jet-subsidized?
metrics: sortEntropy (delta), dTfinal, workInJ, extractableJ, measuredBits, erasureCostJ
E6.paper_role: causal decomposition of sorting: external work subsidy vs information-dependent selection

E7.label: Generalization Sweep (density × noise)
E7.question: Does the learned sorting policy transfer across physics regimes (sparse/clean → dense/noisy)?

E8.label: Information-Limited Demons
E8.question: What is the behavioral price of less measurement/memory (adaptive vs fixed vs mem4)?
E8.paper_role: information/measurement-budget manipulation (behavioral price of reduced information use)

E9.label: Pressure Demon
E9.question: Can the FAFB fly brain, as the valve controller, build ΔP and do net positive spring work against the Landauer bill?
E9.note: Preregistered 20-seed validation ALREADY RUN (E9_VALIDATION.csv): primary paired neural-frozen test workJEp verdict NO_EVIDENCE; neural vs never_open loop-alive floor SUCCESS; demon_speed vs never_open SUCCESS; speed vs neural decisionAccuracy SUCCESS (0.91 vs 0.52).
E9.paper_role: closed-loop work-extraction test with the connectome brain as valve controller

E10.label: Smoluchowski Trapdoor
E10.question: Does a spring trapdoor (passive or brain-gated) sort the gas? (Expected: no — equilibrium wins.)
E10.note: Preregistered 12-seed validation ALREADY RUN (E10_VALIDATION.csv): primary neural-vs-frozen netSortedProxy verdict NO_EVIDENCE (as expected); physics light-vs-heavy crossingRate SUCCESS (passive physics works as expected).
E10.paper_role: negative control: passive/misfitted actuator cannot sort — the required role of information-dependent control

E11.label: Feynman Ratchet & Pawl
E11.question: Does the ratchet extract work only while Th > Tc (and nothing at equilibrium), brain-pawl included?

conditions.ratchet_neural: FAFB brain pawl at equilibrium bath (learning)

E11.note: Preregistered 12-seed validation ALREADY RUN (E11_VALIDATION.csv): PHYSICS gradient-vs-equilibrium netPerEpisode SUCCESS (15.7 vs -3.5); heavy-load REVERSED (monotone load response); neural-vs-frozen reward SUCCESS (learning modifies behavior) but workJEp DIRECTION_ONLY (no positive work extraction at equilibrium).
E11.paper_role: second-law boundary: rectification requires a temperature gradient; brain-pawl does not violate it
